changeSet.author: bquinlivan
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Relationship_Fields] AS select O.ID, O.IntersectTypeID, O.Subject, O.SubjectID, O.SubjectTypeName, O.SubjectName, O.Object, O.ObjectID, O.ObjectTypeName, O.ObjectName, F.FieldTypeID, FT.Name as FieldName, FT.FriendlyName as FieldFriendlyName, F.FormattedValue as FieldValue from IntersectDetail O inner join Field F on F.IntersectID = O.ID inner join FieldType FT on FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID
changeSet.rollback: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Relationship_Fields] AS select O.ID, O.IntersectTypeID, O.Subject, O.SubjectID, O.SubjectTypeName, O.SubjectName, O.Object, O.ObjectID, O.ObjectTypeName, O.ObjectName, F.FieldTypeID, FT.Name as FieldName, FT.FriendlyName as FieldFriendlyName, F.FormattedValue as FieldValue from IntersectDetail O inner join Field F on F.ObjectType = 'Intersect' and F.ObjectID = O.ID inner join FieldType FT on FT.ID = F.FieldTypeID
